parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specified region.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the resource group.

> If this parameter is omitted, details for all resource groups are returned. Otherwise, only details for the specified resource group are returned.
